red-magnet-1: Set a die to 1, on your roll or a rival’s. Your rival plays first, then you may answer. The last Magnet decides.
red-magnet-2: Set a die to 2, on your roll or a rival’s. Your rival plays first, then you may answer. The last Magnet decides.
red-magnet-3: Set a die to 3, on your roll or a rival’s. Your rival plays first, then you may answer. The last Magnet decides.
red-magnet-4: Set a die to 4, on your roll or a rival’s. Your rival plays first, then you may answer. The last Magnet decides.
red-magnet-5: Set a die to 5, on your roll or a rival’s. Your rival plays first, then you may answer. The last Magnet decides.
red-magnet-6: Set a die to 6, on your roll or a rival’s. Your rival plays first, then you may answer. The last Magnet decides.
red-claim-jump: Play after a rival excavates. You take their roll and dig, then skip your next Dig. They may jump it back once.
red-survey: Main phase. Your rival shows you their hand.
red-shovel: After the dice. Swap any two cards in the row.
red-demagnetiser: Any time. Cancel a Magnet just played. Discard both.
red-flooded-shaft: When a rival digs a Gem from the row, it stays in the row instead.
red-sonar: Before you excavate, look at the top 6 cards of the mine and put one on the bottom.
red-collapse: When a rival returns their row, they must shuffle it first, so they can't bury your Gems.
red-headlamp: Main phase. Look at the top 3 cards of the mine and put them back in any order.
